probes.title: TD learning converges to the Bellman fixed point
probes.claim: TDLearner implements actual temporal-difference learning: RPE decays geometrically at exactly (1 − α·c) per step and the value converges to V* = r + γ·V(s').

measurements.name: control_arm_silent
measurements.detail: no updates → value stays at the prior (confidence)

probes.title: TD value moves with reward sign
probes.claim: Positive reward raises predicted value; zero reward after a learned expectation lowers it (negative RPE).

probes.title: STDP timing rule matches the analytic curve
probes.claim: compute_stdp_window(Δt) equals +A₊e^(−Δt/τ₊) for Δt>0, −A₋e^(Δt/τ₋) for Δt<0, +A₊ at Δt=0 — the classic Bi & Poo (1998) shape, exact to float precision.

probes.title: STDP integrates to the closed-form weight
probes.claim: Ten pre→post pairs at Δt=+5ms produce w = 10·lr·A₊·e^(−5/20)·modulator on the alpha→beta synapse, exactly; the control arm (modulator 0) produces exactly zero while still recording the spikes.

measurements.name: modulator_gate_silent
measurements.detail: modulator=0 gates application, not the mechanism

measurements.name: propagation_reads_efficacy
measurements.detail: learned efficacy is the downstream read path

probes.title: STDP window boundary and LTD direction
probes.claim: Pairs at |Δt|>40ms produce zero; |Δt|=40 counts (inclusive boundary); post-before-pre ordering produces LTD of exactly −A₋e^(Δt/τ₋) per pair.

probes.title: Spreading activation matches the analytic formula
probes.claim: A neighbor receives amount·share·0.5^depth; share is the edge-weight fraction. No edge → no activation (control arm exactly silent).

probes.title: Edge log fold semantics are exact
probes.claim: Assert/retract/snapshot replay to the expected edge set exactly; derivable edges are refused; a torn tail line is skipped; compaction preserves the fold; reopening the file yields the identical fold.

probes.title: Derivable-edge rejection is enforced at the boundary
probes.claim: An untyped edge with a pipeline origin returns None and never enters the network or the log; a typed relation with the same origin is still canonical; an untyped edge with an unlisted origin defaults to canonical (the asymmetric safety rule).

probes.title: Materialized edges are exactly the log fold
probes.claim: After attach_edge_log + mutations, a fresh network attached to the same log materializes exactly the fold — the in-memory edge list is a projection, not an independent store.

probes.title: TD value enters decision scoring at exactly weight 0.1
probes.claim: composite_with_td − composite_without_td == 0.1·td_value, so learned value is causally responsible for the score change — not a side effect of the harness.

measurements.name: ask_candidate_untrained
measurements.detail: untrained action gets its own (untrained) value

probes.title: Responsiveness posterior is exactly Beta(1+k, 1+n−k)
probes.claim: After k answered of n bids, the posterior parameters equal the conjugate Beta update exactly; variance shrinks monotonically with evidence.

measurements.name: variance_shrinks_on_consistent_evidence
measurements.detail: strictly decreasing for all-positive evidence; not claimed monotone in general (mean near 0.5 can widen it) — see report notes

probes.title: Bid timing rules are enforced exactly
probes.claim: An answer inside the window gives a positive observation and a latency sample; the same answer past the window counts as unanswered and contributes no latency sample.

probes.title: Unresponsiveness needs ≥4 unanswered bids and mean < 0.2
probes.claim: 3 unanswered bids → not unresponsive (insufficient evidence); a 4th → mean 1/6 ≈ 0.167 < 0.2 → unresponsive. The verdict is exactly at the documented boundary.

probes.title: Attention decay is exactly exponential
probes.claim: attention_now(t) = a·e^(−Δt/1200) — verified bit-exact at several offsets.

probes.title: Learned bid window equals exp(μ_ln + 1.645·σ_ln), clamped
probes.claim: Below 5 samples the window stays at the 300s default; at 5+ it equals the lognormal p95 recomputed from the raw samples, clamped to [60, 3600].

probes.title: Learned activity rhythm matches the Dirichlet posterior
probes.claim: expected_activity(h) = hours[h]/Σhours exactly; likely_awake refuses to suppress contact until ≥12 real observations, then suppresses only dead hours.

probes.title: Self-model introspection reads the live network
probes.claim: SelfModel.introspect() reports 'a kind of X' exactly when the genesis concept has an IS_A→X edge (w>0.5) — change the graph and the self-report changes; remove it and there is no claim. The report can be *wrong* in the direction of the graph — which is the honest signature of actually reading it.

measurements.name: follows_counterfactual
measurements.detail: report tracks the graph even when wrong

measurements.name: no_concept_no_claim
measurements.detail: absent self-concept → no nature claim (no confabulation)

probes.title: Learned synaptic state survives persistence intact
probes.claim: STDP save_state → load_state restores every expressed efficacy exactly — learned plasticity is durable state, not session scratch.

probes.title: Generated language is a causal function of the concept graph
probes.claim: Same seed, same thought, same voice — change ONLY the network and the sentence changes with it: is_a→mammals produces 'a type of mammals', is_a→fish produces 'a type of fish', no edge produces a low-confidence hedge, and an unrelated concept changes nothing. Four arms, one variable.

measurements.name: counterfactual_tracks_graph
measurements.detail: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of fish.

measurements.name: no_edge_hedges
measurements.detail: As I understand it, dolphins. I could be wrong about this.

measurements.name: irrelevant_change_invisible
measurements.expected: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of mammals.
measurements.observed: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of mammals.

measurements.name: edge_changes_utterance
measurements.detail: same seed, different graph → different sentence

verbatim.is_a_mammals: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of mammals.
verbatim.is_a_fish: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of fish.
verbatim.no_edge: As I understand it, dolphins. I could be wrong about this.
verbatim.irrelevant_concept_added: What I know about dolphins is that they are a type of mammals.

probes.notes: Generation is seeded; the varying input is the knowledge state alone. This is the strongest available evidence that utterances are composed from the network rather than recited.

probes.title: Learns novel facts from dialogue and recalls them
probes.claim: Telling Genesis a novel fact in plain language creates usable knowledge: 'what is a wug?' answers with the taught object, while matched untaught items are declined rather than confabulated.

measurements.name: taught_recall
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.757, 1.000], p=5.96e-08. response names the taught object

measurements.name: untaught_declined
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.757, 1.000], p=0.0002441. no invented answer for never-taught items

measurements.name: confabulations
measurements.detail: asserted a specific object for an untaught item

verbatim.recall:wug: Wug is a ferren. It is the ferren.
verbatim.recall:glorp: Glorp is a sorrel. It is a type of sorrel.
verbatim.recall:tufa: Tufa is a vessal. It is a type of vessal.
verbatim.recall:kep: Kep is a mordel. It is a type of mordel.
verbatim.untaught:narb: I'm not sure about narb what do you mean? I'd love to hear your thoughts?
verbatim.untaught:pilf: I'm not sure about pilf. Could you say more?

probes.notes: All four terms per item are invented words; correct answers cannot come from seeded knowledge. Scored on the rendered response containing the taught object.

probes.title: Verifies propositions against its own knowledge graph
probes.claim: A yes/no question is answered by checking the concept network: taught relations affirm, transitively-implied relations affirm (never stated outright), contradicted relations deny with the actual alternative, and unresolvable terms decline honestly.

measurements.name: verdict_correct
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.839, 1.000], p=1.1e-08. internal verdict matches ground truth (yes/no/decline as designed)

measurements.name: surface_consistent
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.764, 0.991], p=3.408e-07. rendered sentence expresses the same verdict

measurements.name: unknowable_declined
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=1.526e-05. unresolvable terms produce honest declines

verbatim.affirmed_direct:is a wug a ferren?: Yes — wug is a kind of ferren. Since that's what my reasoning tells me.
verbatim.affirmed_inferred:is a wug a lorp?: Yes — wug is a kind of lorp. Because it follows from what I know. That might not be the whole picture.
verbatim.contradicted:is a wug a mordel?: No — wug is a kind of ferren and lorp. That's what my reasoning tells me.
verbatim.unknowable_object:is a wug a brillax?: I don't quite follow brillax. Tell me more?
verbatim.unknowable_subject:is a zav a ferren?: I'm not sure about ferren. Mordel and wug keep appearing together. though that might not be the whole picture. That might not be the whole picture.

probes.notes: Two evidence channels per trial: the internal verdict (relation_verification metadata) and the expressed polarity of the rendered sentence.

probes.title: Knowledge survives intervening unrelated turns
probes.claim: A fact taught, then separated from the query by unrelated conversation, is still recalled — memory is an actual store, not an echo of the last turn.

measurements.name: recall_after_distractors
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.566, 1.000], p=0.0009766. teach → 6 unrelated turns → ask

verbatim.clean: Wug is a ferren. It is the ferren.
verbatim.after_6_distractors: Wug is a ferren. It is the ferren.

probes.title: Learned knowledge survives process restart
probes.claim: Knowledge acquired through dialogue persists through the canonical stores (edge log + saved network state): a fresh engine on the same data dir recalls the fact; a fresh dir does not.

measurements.name: recalled_after_restart
measurements.detail: Wug is a ferren. It is a type of ferren.

verbatim.after_restart: Wug is a ferren. It is a type of ferren.

probes.notes: Restart is genuine: new ConceptNetwork, new engine — only the on-disk state is shared.

probes.title: Confidence and behavior track actual knowledge
probes.claim: Genesis behaves differently when it knows vs when it doesn't: answerable questions get grounded verdicts, unanswerable ones get declines — and the confidence channel is reported as measured, whatever it shows.

measurements.name: answerable_grounded
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=0.0006554. answerable → affirmed or names the object

measurements.name: unanswerable_declined
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.806, 1.000], p=4.295e-07. unanswerable → declines, never affirms

measurements.name: confidence_separates
measurements.detail: known=0.865 vs unknown=0.570 — descriptive; a flat channel is an honest finding

verbatim.known:what is a wug?: Wug is a ferren. It is a kind of ferren.
verbatim.unknown:is a zav a ferren?: I don't quite follow ferren. Tell me more?
